Customer information

Privacy notice.

This frontend stores only theme, text-direction and bag preferences in your browser. Contact and consultation forms are not connected and do not transmit information.

Local browser storage

Your selected theme, reading direction and bag contents remain on your device using localStorage. Clearing site data removes them.

Forms

The visible forms validate inputs locally. A production launch requires a secure processor, retention schedule, lawful basis, contact details and an updated notice naming each service used.

Sensitive information

Do not enter diagnoses, prescriptions or a detailed medical history. The consultation flow asks only for product preferences and broad routine goals.

Final review

A qualified legal review and verified business contact are required before accepting customer data or payments.

Last updated: 16 October 2026.
